comment: Labels of the Korean review pipeline. `python3 tools/review/bot.py ensure-labels` creates the missing ones. Only the maintainer labels (accepted, rejected, recheck, needs-maintainer) can start a write action; the bot checks the sender's repository permission before it acts on them.

labels.name: korean-review
labels.description: Review of a Korean line

labels.name: korean:correction
labels.description: Suggested correction of a Korean line

labels.name: korean:approve
labels.description: Approval of one Korean line

labels.name: korean:batch-approve
labels.description: Approval of a whole review page

labels.name: korean:general
labels.description: Question about Korean style or wording

labels.name: bot:stale
labels.description: The line changed since the form was filled in

labels.name: bot:unknown-line
labels.description: The line id does not exist

labels.name: bot:invalid
labels.description: The form is incomplete or malformed

labels.name: bot:lint-error
labels.description: The suggestion fails the Korean linter

labels.name: bot:lint-ok
labels.description: The suggestion passes the Korean linter

labels.name: approval:pending
labels.description: Valid approval, waiting for the daily batch

labels.name: approval:counted
labels.description: Approval written to review-status.json

labels.name: approval:ignored
labels.description: Approval that does not count (see the bot comment)

labels.name: needs-maintainer
labels.description: Waiting for a maintainer decision

labels.name: needs-native
labels.description: Line that needs a native speaker

labels.name: accepted
labels.description: Maintainer: apply this correction

labels.name: rejected
labels.description: Maintainer: do not apply this correction

labels.name: applied
labels.description: The correction was turned into a pull request or a task

labels.name: credited
labels.description: The merged correction was credited to the reviewer

labels.name: generator-rule
labels.description: A generator rule needs a fix

labels.name: good-first-review
labels.description: Easy to review without any setup

labels.name: recheck
labels.description: Maintainer: run the bot checks again
